positive_tests: Paired media switching preserves time, volume, mute, rate, and play intent.
Rejected play resumption leaves a visible paused state.
Native controls change seek, volume, mute, rate, and module position.
Video and audio pages each render one full player and one queue.
Switching and destruction release native media and object URLs.
Playback events remain attributed to the active lesson while a candidate is pending.
Only the newest deferred concurrent lesson selection commits lesson, session, media, and render state.
Full frontend suite passed with 79 tests.
Production build passed with 34 transformed modules.
negative_tests: An unavailable alternate format does not change state or render a toggle.
An alternate metadata failure preserves the current session and closes the failed candidate.
A stale catalog mapping renders an actionable local-media state.
The global mini-player surface and lifecycle are absent.
Markup-shaped lesson titles do not create injected elements.
An obsolete deferred candidate cannot replace the newest selection and closes its object URL.

Lesson, session, media, listeners, title, transcript, format controls, and queue commit together only for the current validated candidate.
